task_objective: Port audit_plugins.py, security-policy.yml, and security-allowlist.yml with cache invalidation fixes, required cache parameter signatures, and tag resolution failure handling.
design_decisions: Ported audit_plugins.py (~2.7k lines) keeping enforcement in advisory mode: report-only.
Restructured audit_repository cache check to run load_cached_report_predownload before download_zip, eliminating unnecessary ZIP downloads on cache hits.
Required audit_context_hash and resolved_tag_commit_sha parameters in _cache_key, load_cached_report, and save_cached_report to prevent silent fallback to un-contextualized cache keys.

Added check for commit_sha resolution failure in audit_repository: if tag_name cannot be resolved to a commit SHA, audit_repository sets report.final_classification = 'AUDIT_ERROR' and returns immediately without reading or writing cache.
Included security-allowlist.yml in workflow cache key hash in .github/workflows/scheduled-security-audit.yml.
Patched _resolve_ref_to_commit_and_tree_sha in TestAuditRepositoryMocked setUp to ensure all network calls remain mocked.
